rig.control_contract: HarnessRoot/Attach fixed to body. RearCenter controls posterior support. RearGrab_L/R are moving hand targets. Unity path solver must update 16 Span bones; no Blender drivers/constraints.
rig.deform_method: Four separately closed, one-bone straight spans per band, blended rear support and fixed tails. Positive local Y stretch. Intentional 3.5mm seam overlap per span end; not cloth simulation.

independent_controls.note: control isolation test; full connected route requires Span bone updates
control isolation test; full connected route requires Span bone updates

shape_keys.method: Reconstructed four Tighten keys for rebuilt spans and original mirrored fixed-guide/free-tail targets; rear support transferred from Part_Buckles into Part_Harness

assumed_head.method: Analytic ellipsoid, no head mesh created/exported

pose_guide_conventions.matrices: row-major 4x4; translation in final column; Blender armature space in metres
pose_guide_conventions.parent_local: parent pose inverse times bone pose, not Blender matrix_basis
pose_guide_conventions.blender_basis: pose delta relative to rest frames; do not assign directly to Unity localPosition
pose_guide_conventions.retarget: D = sourcePose * inverse(sourceRest); importedPose = D * importedRest after coordinate conversion; source/imported rig object transforms must also be accounted for
pose_guide_conventions.samples: 5 intervals x 41 samples = 205 including repeated boundaries; finite sampled path, no proof for arbitrary trajectories

intentional_contact_policy: Exclude same-band adjacent closed spans, tail/near seam and rear-support/end seam from unintended intersection count. Closed seam overlap is intentional, not zero raw self-contact.

roundtrip.method: Numeric Blender FBX roundtrip; deform matrices retargeted using imported rest frames. No Unity execution.

body_uv_evidence_from_v1.scope: Unchanged body atlas only; not a fresh full harness UV raster test

evidence.method: triangle interior raster + neighboring island scan; not analytic subpixel proof

harness_uv: UV0 regenerated for rebuilt spans, original tail UV retained, rear support reuses tiling harness material; intentional sharing; texture PNGs unchanged
previews: No images generated or changed for this revision. Existing Previews are v1 and do not verify corrected handedness or rig.
